# Administration

This page should help lab members find the right office and current instructions. Administrative rules and funder calls change, so this wiki should point to official sources rather than reproduce details that may go stale.

Usually, when you spend money on behalf of the lab, you will need to contact the research centre administrator (Angélique), who will help you with the administrative procedures, and cc Irene.

## Administrative procedures

When you need something from the ULB website, you have to select French, as the English version of the site is not containing all the information. If you are not fluent in French, use a browser that can translate pages automatically.

### Commuting and Access

If you are paid by the ULB (PhD or Postdoc), you usually can be reimbursed for commuting costs. You can find the relevant information [here](https://portail.ulb.be/en/campus-life/home-work-campus-commuting-expenses).

If the FNRS employs you, you can find a lot of useful info [here](https://www.frs-fnrs.be/en/quick-links/regulations-documents-and-hr-information). Via [this link](https://www.frs-fnrs.be/docs/Reglement-et-documents/RH/Reglement-deplacements-domicile-lieu-de-travail.pdf), you can also find the document about how you can get reimbursed for your home-to-work travel.

If you want to access the buildings D (our office) when it is closed (weekend and holidays), you need to request a badge. You can do so by sending an email to dispatching\@ulb.be from your ULB email address.

### Purchasing, Travel and General Information

- Purchases: Go to Finances, achats et comptabilité → [Achats et magasin généraux](https://portail.ulb.be/servlet/com.jsbsoft.jtf.core.SG?EXT=core&PROC=SAISIE_LISTE_SOUS_RUBRIQUES_FRONT&ACTION=LISTER&PROFONDEUR=0&RH=1530796966466&RF=1530796966466&RUBRIQUE=1530796966466).
  - For items outside the catalogue, provide two alternatives for comparison.
  - If choosing the more expensive option, justify why the cheapest option was not selected.
- Travel bookings: Go to Finances, achats et comptabilité → Comptabilité → [Missions à l’étranger](https://portail.ulb.be/fr/finances-achats-et-comptabilite/comptabilite2/missions-a-l-etranger) → Réservation via agence.
- Mission authorisation: Find the relevant form under Finances, achats et comptabilité → Comptabilité → [Missions à l’étranger](https://portail.ulb.be/fr/finances-achats-et-comptabilite/comptabilite2/missions-a-l-etranger).
- Air travel restrictions:
  - Check the [map](https://portail.ulb.be/fr/vie-sur-les-campus/acces-et-mobilite/politique-de-mobilite/des-deplacements-internationaux-plus-responsables-faq) (axe 2) under Vers la liste des villes vertes et oranges.
  - The colour code indicates whether flying is prohibited, not recommended, or unrestricted.
- ULB communications: Regularly check the university mailing lists to avoid missing useful opportunities and announcements.
  - Intralettre and ReMind'R provide general university information.

### ERC

If your project is funded by the European Research Council (ERC), you may need to read the following information:

#### Open Access

The publication of research funded by the ERC must be made open access. However, for hybrid journals (i.e., journals that offer both subscription and open access publishing), the ERC does not cover the costs of open access publishing. You must make your accepted version of the manuscript available in an open access repository.

#### Administrative and Financial Guidelines

- Keep all receipts and payment records for audit purposes. Put it in the folder named [Finance](https://universitelibrebruxelles-my.sharepoint.com/shared?id=%2Fpersonal%2Firene%5Fcogliati%5Fdezza%5Fulb%5Fbe%2FDocuments%2FResearch%20Projects%2FResearch%20Projects%2FERC%2FFinance&listurl=%2Fpersonal%2Firene%5Fcogliati%5Fdezza%5Fulb%5Fbe%2FDocuments&viewid=e07eb818%2D692a%2D4d14%2Dbd42%2D3b3ad2fd5917&share=cgrhsyByA7SURZ5C51LqdK%2D0EgUCMu9bP1CkjjOMhpABMTMASg) in the one drive.
- Purchases and reimbursements:
  - Scholarship holders must follow the intranet purchasing procedure; **direct payments cannot be reimbursed. (Never pay by yourself)**
  - Staff on a salary can request reimbursement.
  - ULB does not cover VAT (TVA).
- Timesheets (if you are paid by ERC): Submit timesheets to the Finance Department every month. (walter.manuel.romero.perez\@ulb.be)
  - You need to (1) sent filled timesheets to the Finance Department. (2) print it out, sign it, and put it into Irene's office. (3) save a pdf version of it named as Oct_2026_Yourname.pdf and put it to the [one drive](https://universitelibrebruxelles-my.sharepoint.com/:f:/r/personal/irene_cogliati_dezza_ulb_be/_layouts/15/onedrive.aspx?id=%2Fpersonal%2Firene%5Fcogliati%5Fdezza%5Fulb%5Fbe%2FDocuments%2FResearch%20Projects%2FResearch%20Projects%2FERC%2FTimeSheet&share=cgoKg%2D4Agk%2DsQaFWRfqJz%5FkCEgUCCJqTKwILlVwpOu3z3wuNlw) in the folder with your name.
  - Relative to signatures, the dates should be the last business day of each month or during the first business days of next month. For example, for the month of October-2026, the signing date must be either 30 Oct 2026 or between 03 Nov and 06 Nov at the latest. The supervisor's date may be after or the same as the staff's, but it cannot be before the staff's date.
- Participant payments:
  - Use the ERC-approved payment form (available in Angélique’s office).
  - For Prolific payments, retain all supporting documentation for audit purposes.
- Travel and missions:
  - Always complete the mission authorisation and travel plan.
  - Keep all travel documents and tickets for the audit at the end of each month (30th).
